FACT-3.gloss: John runs 3 hours on the first day

OP-3.gloss: 60 miles divided by 6 hours is 10 mph

RULE-1.gloss: If x runs n hours on day1 and half of n is t, then x runs t hours on day2
RULE-1.formula: ∀x∀n∀t (RunsHoursOnDay(x, day1, n) ∧ Product(0.5, n, t) → RunsHoursOnDay(x, day2, t))

RULE-2.gloss: If x runs n hours on day1 and half of n is t, then x runs t hours on day3
RULE-2.formula: ∀x∀n∀t (RunsHoursOnDay(x, day1, n) ∧ Product(0.5, n, t) → RunsHoursOnDay(x, day3, t))

RULE-3.gloss: If x runs t1 hours on day1, t2 hours on day2, t3 hours on day3, and t1+t2+t3=s, then x's total time is s
RULE-3.formula: ∀x∀t1∀t2∀t3∀s (RunsHoursOnDay(x, day1, t1) ∧ RunsHoursOnDay(x, day2, t2) ∧ RunsHoursOnDay(x, day3, t3) ∧ Sum(t1, t2, t3, s) → TotalTime(x, s))

RULE-4.gloss: If x runs m miles a week, x's total time is t hours, and m divided by t is s, then x's average speed is s mph
RULE-4.formula: ∀x∀m∀t∀s (RunsMilesPerWeek(x, m) ∧ TotalTime(x, t) ∧ Quotient(m, t, s) → Speed(x, s))

INF-1.gloss: John runs 1.5 hours on day2, from FACT-3, OP-1, and RULE-1 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-2.gloss: John runs 1.5 hours on day3, from FACT-3, OP-1, and RULE-2 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-3.gloss: John's total running time is 6 hours, from FACT-3, INF-1, INF-2, OP-2, and RULE-3 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-4.gloss: John's average speed is 10 mph, from FACT-1, INF-3, OP-3, and RULE-4 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens
